_comment: IPO lockup expirations — when insiders/early investors can sell, per the company's S-1. A lockup expiry is a real supply catalyst. Surfaced in the Ask box; the near-expiry monitor (ipo_lockup_alert.py) fires a Telegram alert ahead of each tranche. Earnings-tied tranches have approximate dates (depend on the actual earnings date) — flagged approx:true.

SPCX.structure: UNUSUAL — staggered milestone + time-based release (not a standard single 180-day cliff). Most insiders can sell early; Elon Musk is carved out and locked the FULL YEAR.

tranches.desc: Q2 (Apr–Jun) earnings publication → up to 20% of eligible insider shares unlock (+10% MORE if SPCX is ≥30% above the $135 offer, i.e. ≥$175.50, at that point). Date approximate (first quarterly report).
Q3 (Jul–Sep) earnings publication → +28% of eligible shares unlock. Date approximate.
Standard 180-day expiry — full remainder of eligible (non-Musk) shares comes off restriction
ELON MUSK lockup expiry — Musk is carved out of all early releases and locked the full year (no early-sale exceptions)

SPCX.notes: Per S-1 coverage (CNBC/Motley Fool/Yahoo, May 2026). Earnings-tied tranches (Q2 ~late-Jul, Q3 ~late-Oct) move with the actual report dates. The +10% bonus tranche is conditional on price ≥$175.50 at Q2 earnings. Index forced-buys (S&P/Nasdaq inclusion) are a SEPARATE supply event. Verify primary doc on SEC EDGAR.
